methodology.policy: official observation and sandbox services; prerequisite reads through the official read tool
methodology.known_inputs: fixtures supply replacement text; prerequisite reads retain the official default bounded output window
methodology.setup: one persistent provider per host/version/policy, including native process handshake; first host module import is cold
methodology.timed_region: sum of actual tool execution durations; fixture reset, external updates and byte verification are outside
methodology.tool_bytes: UTF-8 JSON.stringify arguments and complete ToolRuntime result at the local tool boundary
methodology.bridge_bytes: actual native child stdin/stdout bytes during warm tool calls; handshake and process startup belong to setup
methodology.native_content_encoding: legacy byte arrays selected after the normal capability handshake
methodology.correctness: independent expected storage bytes, complete workspace file set and expected host error code/message; identical edit is rejected by official argument parser, identical write succeeds
methodology.ordering: host versions in supplied order; original then native per policy; scenarios in fixture order; persistent process warmed per scenario
methodology.batch_fixtures: historical batch fixture names are retained; each requested edit executes one official edit tool call
methodology.scope: local deterministic host/tool execution; model generation, billing and interactive approval latency are outside this measurement
